title: Outage windows
summary: A hand-drawn gantt of the outage, degraded and partial windows, one bar per window on its lane, with dashed rules at the timestamps and each bar's duration on it. Hover a bar for its card, click it for the full entry. The page renders one under the summary whenever the retro has a window; declare one to pick the lanes or a subset of windows.
belongs: Overview. A declared subset also fits a sub-incident's cause card.

windows.description: window ids to draw; default every window

lanes.description: one lane per team, per sub-incident, or per window; default incident when the retro has sub-incidents, else team when any window names one, else none

marks.description: draw the timestamp rules; default true
